title: Figure 28: Monthly Distribution of 'Other'-Evaluated vs. Remaining Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Other" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Other" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July has the longest bars, followed by August. Caption: "FIGURE 28 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS OTHER VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS OTHER"; drawing A-7506.
